description: This file contains RISC-V architecture-specific fatal error handling and exception management code for Zephyr OS, including functions for handling fatal errors, exception causes, stack pointer validation, and user space fault handling.

methods.name: z_riscv_fatal_error
methods.description: Handles fatal errors for RISC-V, logs register states if debugging is enabled, then calls the system's fatal error handler.

methods.name: cause_str
methods.description: Returns a string description of the RISC-V exception cause based on the cause code.

methods.name: bad_stack_pointer
methods.description: Checks if the stack pointer prior to an exception was in a guard area or outside allowed bounds, indicating a bad stack pointer.

methods.name: _Fault
methods.description: Handles CPU exceptions, determines if the cause is recoverable, logs cause details, and invokes fatal error handling.

methods.name: arch_syscall_oops
methods.description: Handles user space kernel oops, marks it as a user fault.

methods.name: z_impl_user_fault
methods.description: Handles user space faults, invokes fatal error handling with specific reason.
